Help the desperate [[Vassar]] with delivering the final ingredient to create a [[Ralena's Cure|cure]] for the ailing [[Ralena Stormbringer|Ralena]] to [[Master Ranger Nente]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = mesmer
}}

===Objectives===
* Find Master Ranger Nente.
* Return to Vassar for your reward.

===Reward===
* 300 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Energy Burn}}
* {{skill icon|Illusion of Haste}}


==Walkthrough==
Go north after exiting the [[Sardelac Sanitarium|Sanitarium]]. Nente is standing next to the [[Statue of Balthazar]], where the portal into [[Green Hills County]] used to be.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Vassar
:''"Now that we have the primary ingredient for Ralena's cure, I need someone to take it to '''Master Ranger Nente'''. He can often be found wandering near what used to be called '''Green Hills County'''.''

:''"Will you help me one last time?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I would be glad to help you.
| decline = I can't spare the time.
| ask = Take the '''mossy rock''' to '''Master Ranger Nente'''. He can be found in the northern part of what used to be Green Hills County.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Master Ranger Nente
:''"Vassar sent you? Very good, I've been expecting you. I've gathered the other ingredients necessary, a bit of this cave moss should do the trick. Take this potion back to Vassar, he'll know how to use it to save Ralena. May [[Melandru]] guide you on your return journey, my friend."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Vassar
:''"The cure is ready at last? You don't know what a great service you've done for both Ralena and for me. It's [[Ascalon]]ians like you, <Character name>, that give me some hope for the future."''
